That intermediate commit is unrelated (directory name change). So 251ad37 is the only commit between these that touched the encoding-related code, confirming it as the sole bug-introducing commit.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 251ad374cb1027de108590bef75508f4f497b375

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the file history of `IReportProperties.java` and `ReportProperties.java` with `git log --oneline --all`, which showed only two prior commits besides the fix: `251ad37` ("addition parameters by terry") and `cfeac1a` (an unrelated project-restructuring/directory-rename commit). I inspected `251ad37`'s diff against its parent, then checked whether anything between `251ad37` and the fix (`c395707`) touched the same files — only one unrelated commit (`2126614`, renaming a directory constant) did, ruling it out.

**(2) The introducing change:** `251ad37` replaced the original, correctly-wired `OUT_ENCODING` ("out.encoding") property/getter/setter with two new ones, `OUTPUT_ENCODING` ("html.outputEncoding") and `SOURCE_ENCODING` ("html.sourceEncoding"), and added `validate()` assertions requiring both to be non-null. Critically, these new property keys are looked up via the existing `getReportProperty()` helper, which builds the lookup key as `"report." + type + "." + key"`. Since the new "key" strings themselves already contain a dotted prefix (`html.outputEncoding` / `html.sourceEncoding`), the resulting lookup key becomes something like `report.html.html.outputEncoding` — which never matches any entry in `emma_default.properties` (which only defines `report.html.out.encoding` and `report.xml.out.encoding`, using the original `OUT_ENCODING` convention). As a result, `getOutputEncoding()`/`getSourceEncoding()` always resolve to `null` after this commit, and that `null` is subsequently passed to `OutputStreamWriter`/`InputStreamReader` constructors (and even into the XML `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="null"?>` header), producing broken encoding behavior (and `NullPointerException` from `InputStreamReader(stream, (String) null)` for the HTML source-file embedding path).

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The fix commit `c39570755` exactly reverses this: it removes `OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING` and the associated getters/setters/assertions, restores `OUT_ENCODING`-based `getOutEncoding()/setOutEncoding()`, and adds a properly-named `IN_ENCODING` for the source-reading path — updating every call site (`html`, `txt`, `xml` `ReportGenerator`s) to use `getOutEncoding()`/`getInEncoding()` instead of `getOutputEncoding()`/`getSourceEncoding()`. This is a near line-for-line revert of `251ad37`'s renaming, and `emma_default.properties` (unchanged throughout) only ever matches the `out.encoding` key convention that `251ad37` broke — strongly confirming that `251ad37` is what introduced the defect that `c395707` fixes.

I'm highly confident in this attribution since the fix is essentially a direct revert of the one historical commit that touched these exact code paths, with no other intervening commits modifying the same logic.
